item.title: EIA Edges 2026 USA Oil Output Forecast Closer to 14MM Bpd
item.description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration further raised its U.S. crude oil production forecast for 2026 in its latest short term energy outlook.

item.title: EQT, Range Resources to merge in $50bn all-stock deal
item.description: EQT has agreed to acquire rival Appalachian Basin producer Range Resources in an all-stock transaction that would create a US natural gas entity with a pro forma enterprise value of more than $50bn.
